name: FermiWick 0.2.0
body:
Fermion ladder operators in the Wolfram Language, as symbols and as matrices: normal ordering with compact local operators, Wick's theorem in Gaussian states declared by their symmetries, mean field of any order, Gutzwiller projectors, and exact diagonalisation on symmetry sectors.

Install it with

```mathematica
PacletInstall["https://github.com/n4sd4q/FermiWick/releases/download/v0.2.0/FermiWick-0.2.0.paclet"]
Needs["FermiWick`"]
```

Website: https://n4sd4q.github.io/FermiWick/ · the showcase and the manual are attached as PDFs.
